issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: 1752vc Pitch Deck Analyzer
products.tagline: Know what investors will say before you ever hit send.
products.summaryZh: 在发送之前，先了解投资者会说什么。
products.descriptionZh: Pitch Deck Analyzer可在几分钟内提供投资者级别的反馈——基于25,000多份真实演示文稿及后续投资者决策训练而成。上传您的文稿，即可获得逐页的可融资性反馈——按阶段校准，检查叙事连贯性，并交叉核对您的陈述是否存在投资者会发现的矛盾。在发送之前，精确了解您在哪里失去说服力。由1752vc打造，该风投公司每年评估4,000多家初创企业。
products.description: The Pitch Deck Analyzer gives you investor-grade feedback in minutes — trained on 25,000+ real decks and the investor decisions that followed. Upload yours and get slide-by-slide fundability feedback — stage-calibrated, checking narrative cohesion and cross-checking your claims for contradictions investors will catch. Know exactly where you lose conviction before you ever hit send. Built by 1752vc, a VC firm evaluating 4,000+ startups a year.

products.name: Hy4 preview
products.tagline: Tencent’s 770B open model for long-horizon work
products.summaryZh: 腾讯770B开源模型，面向长周期任务
products.descriptionZh: Hy4 Preview是腾讯推出的770B MoE模型（49B激活参数，1M上下文），专为长周期智能体任务设计。它能自主处理编码、游戏开发和复杂文档分析，在交付前自行运行测试并修复漏洞。
products.description: Hy4 Preview is a 770B MoE model (49B active, 1M context) from Tencent, built for long-horizon agentic tasks. It autonomously handles coding, game dev, and complex document analysis, running its own tests and fixing bugs before delivery.

products.name: Cohere Parse 5
products.tagline: Turn complex docs, tables & images into AI-ready data
products.summaryZh: 将复杂的文档、表格和图像转化为AI可用的数据
products.descriptionZh: Parse是Cohere的文档视觉解析模型。它将企业图像和文档中的非结构化数据转换为结构化的数据，供下游AI代理和应用使用。支持OCR、表格/图表/图像处理，以及通过边界框进行视觉定位，覆盖9种语言。可通过API、云或完全本地/离线环境部署。
products.description: Parse is Cohere's document vision parsing model. It transforms unstructured data in enterprise images and documents into structured data that downstream AI agents and applications can use. Handles OCR, tables/diagrams/images, and visual grounding via bounding boxes, across 9 languages. Deploy via API, cloud, or fully on-prem/air-gapped.

products.name: seendiff
products.tagline: Code diff viewer with progress tracking
products.summaryZh: 带进度跟踪的代码差异查看器
products.descriptionZh: 编码代理能生成巨大的代码差异。仍需要有人去阅读。seendiff是一款针对大型变更的本地差异工具。跟踪你已查看的内容，分块审查，并让编码代理解释其自身的工作。
products.description: Coding agent can create huge code diffs. Someone still has to read it. seendiff is a local diff tool for large changes. Track what you've seen, review in chunks, and pull the coding agent in to explain its own work.

products.name: Neo
products.tagline: A novel-writing tool from the author of Silo
products.summaryZh: 《Silo》作者出品的写作工具
products.descriptionZh: NEO诞生于使用众多写作工具后，始终未能找到“那一个”的体验。NEO并不试图包揽一切，它只希望帮助你完成初稿。无干扰、极简界面，所有进行中的作品一目了然，最重要的是，在写作时，它能将你的手稿排版成书的样子。排版只需按回车键，其余交给NEO。
products.description: NEO was created after using lots of writing tools and never quite finding "the one." NEO doesn't try to do everything; it just wants you to get that rough draft written. Distraction free, minimal UI, see all your WIPs in one place, and most importantly, it formats your manuscripts to look like a book while you write. All you need for formatting is the Enter key. NEO does the rest.

products.name: publicdesktop.lol
products.tagline: Public computer of the internet
products.summaryZh: 公共互联网计算机
products.descriptionZh: 在互联网公共电脑上购买一个永久性的10美元图标位置，或竞标控制其公共歌曲。
products.description: Buy a permanent $10 icon location on the internet's public computer, or bid to control its public song.

products.name: Cursor Craft v2
products.tagline: Custom Mac cursors, rebuilt for v2
products.summaryZh: 为v2重新设计的自定义Mac光标
products.descriptionZh: Cursor Craft v2 是一款重新构建的 macOS 应用，用于浏览、预览和应用自定义光标包。新版本增加了重新设计的界面、更快的浏览速度、更清晰的离线状态、改进的光标渲染，并为动态和动画光标包做好了准备。
products.description: Cursor Craft v2 is a rebuilt macOS app for browsing, previewing, and applying custom cursor packs. The new version adds a redesigned interface, faster browsing, clearer offline states, improved cursor rendering, and prepares the app for dynamic and animated cursor packs.

products.name: God’s Eye View
products.tagline: Spy satellite simulator in your browser but the data is real
products.summaryZh: 浏览器中的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的
products.descriptionZh: 浏览器中的间谍卫星模拟器——随后你发现数据源是公开的，数据是真实的。照片级逼真的3D地球，实时显示飞机、船只、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头。通过实时AI代理，使用免提语音控制与地球对话。完全开源，采用MIT许可证，在浏览器中运行，旨在以极低成本甚至零成本供个人探索。不留任何角落！
products.description: A spy satellite simulator in your browser - then you realize the sources are public and the data is real. Photorealistic 3D globe with live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras. Talk to the planet with hands-free voice control using a realtime AI agent. Fully open source under MIT license, runs in your browser and is designed to cost little to nothing for personal exploration. No place left behind!

products.name: Mossy
products.tagline: A desk plant that wilts when you need a break
products.summaryZh: 一株在你需要休息时会枯萎的桌面植物
products.descriptionZh: Mossy是一种生活在Mac桌面上的小植物。你坐得越久不休息，它就越枯萎。你写一句话，说明你的休息应该是什么。伸展我酸痛的背。做20个俯卧撑。教我一句西班牙语。就让我站起来。AI根据那句话生成每次休息任务，一次一个，并配有计时器。它从不遮挡或调暗你的屏幕。忽略它也是一种正常的使用方式。免费，无需账户，1.4 MB，原生应用，macOS 12及以上。
products.description: Mossy is a small plant that lives on your Mac desktop. The longer you sit without a break, the more it wilts. You write one sentence about what your breaks should be. Stretch my bad back. 20 push-ups. Teach me a Spanish word. Just make me stand up. An AI writes every break from that sentence, one task at a time, with a timer. It never blocks or dims your screen. Ignoring it is a normal way to use it. Free, no account, 1.4 MB, native, macOS 12+.

products.name: WIT
products.tagline: Spot potential misunderstandings across global Englishes
products.summaryZh: 识别全球英语中可能存在的误解。
products.descriptionZh: WIT是一款面向创始人和全球团队的AI沟通检查工具。粘贴邮件、Slack消息或产品文案，即可查看其在美国、印度和新加坡英语环境中的传达效果，理解原因，并获得不失去个人风格的更清晰替代方案。在点击发送前，确认你的信息是否传达到位。
products.description: WIT is an AI communication check for founders and global teams. Paste an email, Slack message or product copy to see how it may land across American, Indian and Singapore English, understand why and get a clearer alternative without losing your voice. Before you hit send, see if your message travels.

products.name: Staats
products.tagline: Ask your coding agent how your site is doing
products.summaryZh: 询问你的编码代理，你的网站运行得如何。
products.descriptionZh: Agent原生、无Cookie的网站分析。你的编码代理衡量部署、标记变更，并基于证据建议下一步行动。无仪表盘，无图表可读。
products.description: Agent-native, cookieless site analytics. Your coding agent measures deploys, flags changes, and suggests next moves with evidence. No dashboard, no charts to read.

products.name: Einfall
products.tagline: Capture fugitive thoughts + route them to where they belong
products.summaryZh: 捕捉飘忽的思绪，并将它们归置到应属之处。
products.descriptionZh: Einfall捕捉那些稍纵即逝的念头——那些在最奇怪时刻闯入脑海的想法——在它们消失之前。在Mac、iPhone和iPad上，通过菜单栏、分享面板、快捷指令、小组件、Spotlight和Siri，快速轻松地记录。通过将想法发送到提醒事项、日历、文件、快捷指令，或通过MCP让AI代理接管，来处理这些思绪。记录功能免费且无限制。前15次路由操作后，一次性支付29.99美元即可解锁无限路由。
products.description: Einfall catches the fugitive thought — the one that falls into your head at the strangest times — before it's gone. Capture quick and easy on Mac, iPhone and iPad, from the menu bar, share sheet, Shortcuts, widgets, Spotlight and Siri. Process the thoughts by sending them to Reminders, Calendar, Files, a Shortcut, or by giving your AI agent control via MCP. Capture is free and unlimited. After the first 15 routing actions, a one-time $29.99 purchase unlocks unlimited routing.

products.name: Tiles
products.tagline: Turning desktop chaos into curated spaces.
products.summaryZh: 将桌面混乱转化为精心整理的空间。
products.descriptionZh: 使用Tiles简化日常操作，消除窗口杂乱，它是macOS的终极工作区管理器。无论是从深度编码切换到客户会议，还是同时处理研究、写作和设计工具，Tiles都能让你捕捉理想的桌面布局，并通过单击、键盘快捷键或小组件一键恢复。
products.description: Streamline your daily workflow and eliminate window clutter with Tiles, the ultimate workspace manager for macOS. Whether you're transitioning from deep coding sessions to client meetings, or juggling research, writing, and design tools, Tiles lets you capture your ideal desktop layout's and bring them back with a single click, keyboard shortcut, or widget.

products.name: Any Command
products.tagline: Turn your phone into a second screen and trackpad for PC
products.summaryZh: 将手机变成电脑的第二屏幕和触控板。
products.descriptionZh: Any Command可将安卓手机变为Windows的第二屏幕、触控板、键盘和游戏手柄。将单个窗口流式传输至手机并在其上使用，同时电影在显示器上保持全屏播放。可在自有网络或蓝牙上运行，无需在PC端安装。免费层级，无需账户，PC应用为普通Windows安装程序。
products.description: Any Command turns an Android phone into a second screen, trackpad, keyboard and gamepad for Windows. Stream one window to the phone and use it there while a film stays fullscreen on the monitor. Runs on your own network, or over Bluetooth with no PC install. Free tier, no account, and the PC app is a plain Windows install.

products.name: Democruit
products.tagline: Your candidate-first career companion, from resume to offer
products.summaryZh: 从简历到录用，你的求职全程伙伴。
products.descriptionZh: Democruit借助AI指导，助你从简历到录用每一步。与单一提示工具不同，它帮助你理解如何改进每份申请，而非仅生成一份。提供ATS分析、定制求职信、申请跟踪及个人简历网站。旨在助你获得面试机会，而非仅创建文档。无需订阅，现付50%，若12个月内成功入职再付余款（无需证明）。最近被裁员？联系我们即可免费使用。
products.description: Democruit takes you from resume to offer with AI-powered guidance at every step. Unlike single-prompt tools, it helps you understand how to improve every application, not just generate one. Get ATS analysis, tailored cover letters, application tracking, and a personal resume website. Designed to help you land interviews, not just create documents. No subscriptions, pay 50% now and the rest only if you get hired within 12 months (no proof required). Recently laid off? Message us for free access.

products.name: TCTGame : Social Habit Tracker
products.tagline: A Social Habit Game Built for Accountability and Consistency
products.summaryZh: 一款为责任与坚持而设计的社交习惯游戏
products.descriptionZh: TCTGame将习惯养成转化为一场社交游戏。选择你的目标，获取定制每日计划，并发布一条每日日志，同时你的部落为你提供支持并监督你。建立连续记录，赚取经验值，攀升排行榜，并使用深度工作、专注、阅读、冥想、呼吸、瑜伽等工具，帮助你真正坚持到底。
products.description: TCTGame turns habit-building into a social game. Choose your goals, get custom daily plan and post one daily log while your Tribe supports you and keeps you accountable. Build streaks, earn XP, climb the leaderboard and use tools for Deep Work, focus, reading, meditation, breathing, yoga and more to help you actually follow through.

products.name: Mole
products.tagline: A native Mac maintenance app that shows before it cleans
products.summaryZh: 一款原生Mac维护应用，清理前先展示效果。
products.descriptionZh: 清理缓存、卸载和更新应用、检查磁盘空间并监控系统健康。Mole在清理前预览路径和大小，扫描仅在本地进行，可恢复的删除项会移至废纸篓。
products.description: Clean caches, uninstall and update apps, inspect disk space, and monitor system health. Mole previews paths and sizes before cleanup, keeps scans local, and moves recoverable removals to Trash.

products.name: ThriveStack citedby
products.tagline: AI visibility that measures, fixes, and attributes revenue.
products.summaryZh: AI可见性，衡量、修复并归因收入。
products.descriptionZh: 终于，一个AI可见性平台，能够衡量、修复并归因各大AI引擎中的引用，将AI回答转化为可衡量的收入渠道。专为品牌和代理机构的SEO/AEO团队打造，并首次让CMO和CRO能够看到AI可见性如何推动收入管道。分析：AI引擎当前如何引用和推荐你。修复：阻碍你进入回答的内容和网站缺口。归因：AI驱动流量带来的收入。
products.description: Finally, an AI-visibility platform that measures, fixes, and attributes citations across every major AI engine, turning AI answers into a measurable revenue channel. Built for SEO/AEO teams at brands and agencies, and, for the first time, for CMOs and CROs to see how AI visibility moves the revenue pipeline. Analyze: how AI engines cite and recommend you today. Fix: the content and site gaps keeping you out of the answer. Attribute: the revenue AI-driven traffic brings in.

products.name: RawToHEIC
products.tagline: Convert RAW to HEIC inside Apple Photos
products.summaryZh: 在Apple照片中将RAW转换为HEIC
products.descriptionZh: RawToHEIC可直接在iPhone、iPad和Mac的照片分享面板中，将相机RAW和ProRAW文件转换为HEIC格式——体积最多可缩小10倍，且编辑、相册和元数据均完整保留。完全在设备端处理：无需上传，无需账户，无分析追踪。
products.description: RawToHEIC converts camera RAW and ProRAW files to HEIC right from the Photos share sheet on iPhone, iPad, and Mac — up to 10× smaller, with edits, albums, and metadata intact. Entirely on-device: no uploads, no account, no analytics.

products.name: Lubb
products.tagline: A realistic heartbeat for falling asleep
products.summaryZh: 真实的助眠心跳声
products.descriptionZh: Lubb将iPhone变成一个缓慢、真实的心跳，可置于枕头边缘之下。它利用触觉引擎产生轻柔的“怦怦”声，可调节节奏与触感，提供每晚10分钟的免费试用，无需注册账户。专为那些渴望安静、简单且人性化陪伴的夜晚而设计。
products.description: Lubb turns an iPhone into a slow, realistic heartbeat you can place under the edge of your pillow. It uses the Taptic Engine to create a soft lub-dub you can tune for pace and feel, with a free 10-minute nightly trial and no account required. Built for the nights you want something quiet, simple, and human.
